summary: This note documents the DetachableJoint system in Gazebo simulation, which lets two models start rigidly attached and later detach by publishing to a topic, and reattach by publishing to another topic. It explains the tree-only kinematic constraint, the example vehicle with three detachable objects, collision and reattachment caveats (including a DART issue), and the plugin parameters: parent_link, child_model, child_model_link, and the optional detach, attach, output and legacy topic settings.
one_line: Describes the Gazebo DetachableJoint system for attaching and detaching models at runtime via topics, with its tree-topology and collision constraints.
key_facts: The DetachableJoint system allows two models to start off rigidly attached and then detach during simulation by publishing to a topic.
The system internally uses a fixed joint between two links, each belonging to two separate models.
Kinematic topology has to be a tree; kinematic loops are not currently supported.
Once detached, the joint can be re-attached by publishing to a topic.
When reattaching, the child model is attached to the parent model at its current pose/configuration.
The example detachable_joint.sdf demonstrates a four wheel vehicle that holds three objects later detached from the vehicle.
In the example, the parent model is the vehicle and the kinematic topology is world---vehicle_blue---B1 with B2 and B3 also attached to vehicle_blue.
If detached models need to collide with a parent model or other detached models with the same parent, the parent model needs <self_collide> set to true.
Due to an issue in DART, the default physics engine, none of the parent or child models should be in collision in their initial attached state.
Reattaching a child model is not currently supported while the child model and parent model are in contact.
To reattach at a specific pose, the child model can be positioned through a set_pose service call prior to reattaching the joint.
The parameter parent_link names the link in the model containing the system that serves as the parent link in the detachable joint.
The parameter child_model names the model containing the child link in the detachable joint.
The parameter child_model_link names the link in child_model used as the child link.
The optional detach_topic defaults to the pattern /model/<model_name>/detachable_joint/detach and is required to detach child models individually when multiple plugins are used in one model.
The optional attach_topic defaults to /model/<model_name>/detachable_joint/attach and is required to attach child models individually when multiple plugins are used in one model.
The optional output_topic publishes detachment state and defaults to /model/<child_model_name>/detachable_joint/state.
